rules.old:
LogPrintf("Not reloading TLS client certificate %s: %s\n",
                  fs::PathToString(*m_cert), ErrorString())
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "tls_client_certificate_reload_failed", "Not reloading TLS client certificate {certificate_path}: {error}").Field(BCLog::LogField::CertificatePath, fs::PathToString(*m_cert)).Field(BCLog::LogField::Error, ErrorString())
rules.review_note: Preserve Info, exact public certificate filename/error text, lock scope, one-second mtimecheck, TLS policy and retained prior valid context on failure. Log only existing path/error, never PEM/private-key contents. EventBuilder does not inspect the OpenSSL error queue; ErrorString remains inside the existing Info guard and original relative argument order.
